scientific_limitations: Real scalar Dirac-diagonal operators only. On an infinite metric space the canonical Dirac family need not be a Schauder basis; the supremum can be infinite. Equivalent older Lipschitz-algebra multiplier statements remain a residual originality risk. Finite numerical checks do not establish infinite-dimensional claims.
title: Exact norms of Dirac-diagonal operators on real Lipschitz-free spaces
